title: Async data at a synchronous decision point — trace event state
description: Shape of the `state` field for event-carried-state-transfer trace events.

strategy.description: How the synchronous decision gets a value the owning service publishes asynchronously.

clock.description: Seconds since the run started; the only thing that makes data stale.

ttlSeconds.description: Cache TTL; 0 for the strategies that have no cache.

budgetSeconds.description: Declared freshness limit in seconds; 0 while no limit has been declared.

policy.description: What a decision does with a value past the declared limit: serve it flagged (fail open) or refuse (fail closed).

rateService.description: The service that owns the data.

up.description: Whether a synchronous call to it would succeed.

delivering.description: Whether its events currently reach this consumer.

rates.description: What the owner knows right now — its version of the truth.

publishedAt.description: Clock value when the owner produced it.

feed.description: Events published by the owner, in publication order, with their fate at this consumer. Empty unless the strategy is event-carried.

status.description: applied = changed the replica, ignored = duplicate or older version, pending = published but not delivered yet.

replica.description: The consumer's own copy — what a synchronous decision actually reads.

asOf.description: When the value was produced by the owner — not when it was received.

state.description: expired = past the cache TTL; stale = past the declared freshness limit.

decision.description: The decision being made (absent before the first one).

amount.description: Amount in cents of the pair's base currency.

source.description: Where the value backing this decision came from.

reason.description: Why a blocked decision was refused.

quotes.description: Decisions already made, each pinned to the exact value that produced it.

staleQuoted.description: Decisions made on data known to be past its limit.

remoteCalls.description: Blocking calls made inside a decision — the coupling this topic is about.

oldestRateUsed.description: Age in seconds of the oldest value any decision was based on.
